## Topic Area

Introduce your topic area. What did you choose, why did you choose it?\
Our group chose Campus safety as our topic. We decided it would be relevant to current day situations, including news articles about the Cornell 7 case. We are interested in what could be a factor in campus safety and keeping students safe.\

## Research Question

State your research question that you hope to answer with data.\
Is there a relationship between annual undergraduate tuition costs and the rate of reported violent crimes at U.S. colleges and universities?\
